name: magical-plugin-marketplace
description: Merlin Eck's directory of Claude Code and Cowork plugins

plugins.name: exam-podcast
plugins.description: Turn a certification exam guide PDF into a two-voice study podcast: a readable host/expert script where every wrong answer is explained as a common mistake, plus an audio-ready TTS package (dialogue JSON + multi-voice SSML).

plugins.name: 3p-inference-watch
plugins.description: Tracks changes to Claude Desktop on third-party inference. Produces a weekly administrator brief from the release changelog and git-versioned documentation snapshots, then turns that brief into a short social post for LinkedIn or X.

plugins.name: ai-rescue-kit
plugins.description: Diagnose a failing or expensive AI system, prove the fix with an eval harness, cut cost and latency without losing accuracy, and write it up as a client brief. Includes a trace-analyst subagent and a hook that guards eval files from silent edits.

plugins.name: plugin-toolkit
plugins.description: Front gate for a Claude plugin marketplace: reviews, security-checks, builds, imports, fixes, eval-gates, stamps and releases plugins against one numbered house rulebook.
